name: agentlefs
description: Agent permissions for the files your team shares

interface.shortDescription: Agent permissions for the files your team shares
interface.longDescription: agentleFS (afs) gives your AI agents permissions on the files your team shares. An agent reads only what the person who created it can read, every write is kept as a version, and a folder can be shared outside your company. This plugin connects the hosted server with browser sign-in, so there is no token to create or paste, and adds skills for finding what is stored, saving what you work out, and checking who can see what.
